headline: Paignton's New Policy for 2026
short_post:
Paignton Cricket Club has released its updated policy for 2026. This document outlines the club's guidelines, procedures, and commitments for the upcoming season.

[Read the full policy document](/PDFS/PCC%20Policy-2026.pdf)
full_content:
We are pleased to announce the release of Paignton Cricket Club's new policy for 2026. This comprehensive document has been carefully reviewed and updated to reflect our club's values, ensure fair play, and provide clear guidelines for all members, players, and visitors.

The policy covers important areas including:

- Club governance and management
- Player conduct and discipline
- Safety and welfare procedures
- Membership guidelines
- Event organization protocols

We encourage all members to familiarize themselves with the new policy. It represents our commitment to maintaining the highest standards in cricket and community engagement.

[Download the full policy PDF](/PDFS/PCC%20Policy-2026.pdf)
